forbidden_shortcuts: do not loosen replay or protected-key thresholds
do not lengthen PPO before this one-smoke gate passes
do not promote if M183 M170 or protected key fails
hypothesis: Trajectory-level action anchoring should preserve the failed M183 M170 row and protected key better than M233's first-action snippet-only repair.
success_criteria: run exactly one 1024-step PPO smoke from M224 with M232 snippet anchor and M235 trajectory anchor
retain M183 M170 replay at 17/17 success drops
pass protected key 9944 within the existing normal-margin window
retain behavior seed success at the M224 level
do not repeat or lengthen PPO before the one-smoke result is audited
failure_criteria: trajectory_action_anchor_loss_mean is missing from training metrics

commands.name: m237_train
commands.command: Create a M237 smoke config from M233 with trajectory_action_anchor pointing to M235, then run one 1024-step PPO smoke from M224.

commands.name: m237_gates
commands.command: Evaluate fixed objective, replay gates, behavior seeds, and protected key before any repeat or longer PPO.

decision_rule: M237 may admit only a repeat PPO smoke if trajectory-anchor metrics are present and replay behavior protected-key gates all pass. Any M183 M170 or protected-key failure rejects the smoke and triggers audit.
next_blocker: Run one trajectory-anchored PPO smoke and decide between repeat PPO or trajectory-anchor audit.
